**Asia pre-market reactions — 2026-10-23 (Fri)**

**TL;DR**

- **All three open markets finished up, but only after violent intraday reversals.** Nikkei **-0.34%** (62,693.16, -214.68 pts, closed near the day's high after being down 1,082 pts at the morning close), KOSPI **+0.30%** (5,550.30, +16.53 pts, closed at the session high after opening -2.36% and falling to -4.12%), HSI **+0.69%** (23,093.37, +158.69 pts, reclaimed 23,000 in the afternoon).
- Hang Seng Tech **+2.05%** to 3,871.66.
- **Taiwan was closed all day** — Typhoon Champi (薔琵) forced TWSE + TPEx to shut the concentrated market and OTC board for Fri 23 Oct, with settlement deferred.
- TWSE is also shut Mon 26 Oct (substitute holiday); Taiwan resumes **Tue 27 Oct**. TW figures below are the **prior session (2026-10-22)**, labelled as such.
- **The one genuine, company-specific catalyst was SK hynix** (000660.KS **+4.42%**, ₩1,277,000):
- it **scrapped the US IPO review for its Solidigm NAND unit**, easing dilution/governance worries after the FSC said a dual listing fell under the split-listing guidelines.
- Samsung E&A (028050.KS **+7.94%**) extended its post-earnings run on the day the ₩780bn buyback window opened.
- Everything else tracked the macro: AI-capex financing doubts, an oil shock, and a US tech rout.
- **Macro driver: oil.** Brent settled **+3.1% at $116.72**, a four-year high (highest since June 2022), on Houthi attacks on Saudi targets and reports of possible renewed US strikes on Iran.
- US chip selling set the tone — **SOX -6.72%** with all 30 constituents lower, lowest since 29 Jul.
- **Widest reaction: MINIMAX-W 0100.HK +16.74%** (HK, AI apps). Worst: **Convano 6574.T -5.83%** (JP, after a second consecutive Axcel Mark share-lockup unwind) and **S-Oil 010950.KS -5.29%** (KR).

- **data-quality defect found and corrected —
- Yahoo's index chart series lags one bar.** The `close` array's last populated bar was dated **2026-10-22** for all three open indices, while `meta.regularMarketPrice` carried the **2026-10-23** close and `meta.regularMarketChangePercent` was computed against the *prior* close.
- Taking the series' last bar as "today" would have reported Thursday's closes and Thursday's changes.
- Every index level and Δ% in this brief was therefore taken from `meta.regularMarketPrice` against the last populated series close, then cross-checked against publishers.
- **Note this is the opposite of the TW case**, where the closed-market placeholder bar duplicated the prior close and made the computed Δ% read 0.00
- **conflict resolved:** 2600.HK was mislabelled CLP Holdings in the prior run's working notes; two publishers (智通/金融界 and 觀點網) identify it as 中國鋁業 / Aluminum Corp of China (Chalco).
